mapper.select: SELECT c.chr_name AS chromosome, c.chr_length_bp AS length_bp, CONCAT('Chr ', c.chr_name) AS display_name, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cytoband b WHERE b.chromosome_id = c.chromosome_id ) AS cytoband_count FROM chromosome c ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.chr_name REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(c.chr_name AS UNSIGNED) WHEN c.chr_name = 'X' THEN 100 WHEN c.chr_name = 'Y' THEN 101 WHEN c.chr_name = 'MT' THEN 102 ELSE 999 END, c.chr_name

SELECT b.cytoband_id AS band_id, c.chr_name AS chromosome, b.band_name, b.start_bp, b.stop_bp AS end_bp, b.gie_stain FROM cytoband b JOIN chromosome c ON c.chromosome_id = b.chromosome_id WHERE c.chr_name = #{chromosome} ORDER BY b.start_bp

SELECT b.cytoband_id AS band_id, c.chr_name AS chromosome, b.band_name, b.start_bp, b.stop_bp AS end_bp, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dbm.disease_id) FROM disease_band_map dbm WHERE dbm.cytoband_id = b.cytoband_id ) AS disease_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dgm.gene_id) FROM disease_band_map dbm JOIN disease_gene_map dgm ON dbm.disease_id = dgm.disease_id WHERE dbm.cytoband_id = b.cytoband_id ) AS gene_count, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM small_variant sv WHERE sv.chromosome_id = b.chromosome_id AND sv.start_bp BETWEEN b.start_bp AND b.stop_bp ) AS small_variant_count, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM structural_variant stv WHERE stv.chromosome_id = b.chromosome_id AND stv.start_bp <= b.stop_bp AND stv.end_bp >= b.start_bp ) AS structural_variant_count FROM cytoband b JOIN chromosome c ON c.chromosome_id = b.chromosome_id WHERE b.cytoband_id = #{bandId} LIMIT 1
